# that actually observes the reporting level; reading the rule classes does not, because 23 of 31 magnitude
# channels build their subject outside the rule class (in AbstractRule helpers or in the metric record).

#    most code-smell, annotation) emit nothing here and are NOT covered by this table. Covering them needs a
#    second pass over the rule test fixtures, or a run against a corpus that triggers them.
#  - a channel that fired at only one level here may still be capable of another level on other code. The table
